links.outcome: Predictive AUC of AI application versus doctors and versus simpler models on same data
links.effect: AI application AUC 0.908 vs doctors 0.682 (P<0.001); eXGBM scored highest (56) among six models, above logistic regression (27).
links.quote: The comparative testing revealed that the AI application's predictive capabilities significantly outperformed those of the doctors in terms of AUC values (0.908 vs. 0.682, P <0.001).

screen.reason: The study develops and retrospectively validates a predictive risk model/web app and compares its diagnostic/predictive accuracy against clinicians in a reader comparison, but does not test a specific deployment practice or guardrail.
